task_description: Add a CamScanner-like document scanner page to the Ruralift CRM. The page allows users to search for existing customers, open the device camera, capture multiple photos, enhance them with document-quality processing (contrast, sharpening, B&W), combine into a PDF, and auto-upload to the selected customer's record. Fully mobile-first, separate URL (/scanner.html).

verification.summary: server.js passes syntax check. All key features verified via grep: jsPDF CDN, getUserMedia camera access, autoEnhance/sharpen/adjustBrightness/rotateImage canvas processing, multi-page PDF generation, upload-scanned API endpoint, and sidebar nav link. npm install blocked by network proxy (403 on registry.npmjs.org) but code matches existing patterns exactly. No test framework exists in this project.
